# Review access to administrative roles: a pinned copy of Learn's access reviews tutorial

This folder is an unmodified copy of the Microsoft Learn source page for [Review access to administrative roles using access reviews APIs](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/tutorial-accessreviews-roleassignments). It is Microsoft's tutorial for reviewing privileged role assignments through Microsoft Graph: create a recurring review of users and groups with active or eligible assignments to one Microsoft Entra role, list its instances and decisions, record decisions, apply them, and generate a review history report. It comes from [microsoftgraph/microsoft-graph-docs-contrib](https://github.com/microsoftgraph/microsoft-graph-docs-contrib/blob/a69303123e9701eecbf56568d152ece936a97f1e/concepts/tutorial-accessreviews-roleassignments.md) at commit `a69303123e9701eecbf56568d152ece936a97f1e` (October 30, 2026); the page last changed on July 3, 2026. The repository's documentation license (`LICENSE`) is CC BY 4.0 and its code license (`LICENSE-CODE`) is MIT.

**Why the page, not just the requests.** The HTTP requests exist only inside this Learn page. Pinning the page byte for byte keeps the copy checkable against upstream. `examples/privileged-access/tests/AccessReviewsSampleHarness.ps1` extracts the requests, unmodified, at test time, and `tests/AccessReviews.Tests.ps1` sends the create request to the example's fake Graph and checks what the sample does and leaves out. Nothing is sent to a tenant. The [developer workbook *Building Privileged Access*, Chapter 07](../../../docs/project-plans/developer-workbooks/privileged-access/07-access-reviews-of-privileged-roles.md) links Learn rather than quoting the page.

**How it stays honest.**

- `snapshot.json` records the upstream repository, path, commit, dates, licenses, the upstream git blob hash of each file and the size and SHA-256 of every file here. Each file's git blob hash was checked against the upstream tree at that commit with `gh api` before the manifest was written. `scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py` fails if any file is changed, added or removed.
- The weekly source watch follows commits to the upstream page (`graph-access-reviews-roles-tutorial-commits` in `data/source-watch/feeds.json`) and reports each one in its issue under DW (developer workbooks).
- To move to a newer upstream commit: review the upstream change, copy the page from that commit, regenerate `snapshot.json`, rerun `examples/privileged-access/tests/AccessReviews.Tests.ps1` and the Chapter 07 labs, and open a pull request. Never edit the files here; changes the program needs go in `examples/privileged-access`.

These files keep their upstream bytes, line endings included, so the hashes match the upstream commit.
